title: Vampire Vape Vanilla Cappuccino Tobacco E-Liquid Shortfill 50ml
description: Vampire Vape Koncept Vanilla Cappuccino Tobacco Shortfill delivers a refined blend of earthy Tobacco, smooth Vanilla and aromatic Cappuccino. The Tobacco note anchors the flavour, softened by mellow Vanilla sweetness, while Cappuccino adds a roasted coffee edge for depth and warmth. This 70VG/30PG shortfill is designed for direct-to-lung (DTL) vaping with sub-ohm kits. Each 60ml bottle holds 50ml of nicotine-free e-liquid with room for a 10ml nicotine shot to customise the strength. Produced in the UK, Vampire Vape are known for quality and consistency. The Koncept series highlights bold, flavour-rich profiles in high-VG blends for sub-ohm vapers.
